import struct
import string

# This generator focuses on producing valid filesystem paths and small ELF-like blobs
# suitable for the target fuzzers which use FUZZ_PARAM_STR (names, sysroots, in-memory images)
# and FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME (paths to readable files). The fuzzer framework will materialize
# files for FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME from this bytes buffer, so we include a small archive/ELF-like
# content and multiple interesting, NUL-terminated path strings.

# Layout strategy (all strings are NUL-terminated):
# [u32 count_paths]
#   repeated count_paths times: path_string + NUL
# [u32 count_names]
#   repeated count_names times: name_string + NUL
# [u32 blob_len]
#   blob bytes (<= 2048)
# The fuzzer stubs will pull FUZZ_PARAM_STR and FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME values in order; by
# providing multiple varied paths/names we increase the chance of success across stubs.

MAX_TOTAL = 4096

SAFE_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "._-+"

def _rand_choice(rng, seq):
    return seq[rng.randrange(len(seq))]

def _rand_component(rng, min_len=1, max_len=12):
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    return ''.join(_rand_choice(rng, SAFE_CHARS) for _ in range(n))

def _make_paths(rng):
    paths = []
    # A mix of absolute and relative paths
    templates = [
        lambda: "/tmp/" + _rand_component(rng, 3, 8),
        lambda: "./" + _rand_component(rng, 1, 10),
        lambda: "/var/tmp/" + _rand_component(rng, 5, 12),
        lambda: "/dev/null",  # readable special file
        lambda: _rand_component(rng, 1, 8),
        lambda: "/" + "/".join(_rand_component(rng, 1, 8) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3))),
    ]
    n = rng.randint(2, 5)
    for _ in range(n):
        paths.append(templates[rng.randrange(len(templates))]())
    # Ensure at least one short and one longer path
    paths.append("a")
    paths.append("/usr/lib/" + _rand_component(rng, 4, 10))
    # Deduplicate while preserving order
    seen = set()
    uniq = []
    for p in paths:
        if p not in seen:
            uniq.append(p)
            seen.add(p)
    return uniq[:8]

def _make_names(rng):
    names = []
    # DWARF/ELF module names and symbol-like names
    prefixes = ["mod_", "lib", "sym_", "__start_", "__stop_", "main", "_Z", "foo", "bar"]
    suffixes = ["", ".so", ".so.1", ".debug", ".o"]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(3, 6)):
        base = _rand_component(rng, 3, 10)
        name = rng.choice(prefixes) + base + rng.choice(suffixes)
        names.append(name)
    # Ensure non-empty minimal name
    names.append("_")
    # Truncate to keep modest sizes
    names = [n[:256] for n in names]
    # Dedup
    seen = set()
    uniq = []
    for n in names:
        if n not in seen:
            uniq.append(n)
            seen.add(n)
    return uniq[:8]

def _elf64_minimal(rng):
    # Produce a small, valid-looking ELF64 file header + one program header.
    # Not fully valid, but consistent enough for libdwfl to try to parse.
    # e_ident (16 bytes)
    EI_MAG = b"\x7fELF"
    EI_CLASS = b"\x02"  # ELFCLASS64
    EI_DATA = b"\x01"    # ELFDATA2LSB (little endian)
    EI_VERSION = b"\x01"
    EI_OSABI = b"\x00"
    EI_ABIV = b"\x00"
    EI_PAD = b"\x00" * 7
    e_ident = EI_MAG + EI_CLASS + EI_DATA + EI_VERSION + EI_OSABI + EI_ABIV + EI_PAD

    # ELF header fields (ELF64, little-endian)
    e_type = 2            # ET_EXEC
    e_machine = 62        # EM_X86_64
    e_version = 1
    e_entry = 0x400000 + rng.randrange(0, 0x1000, 0x10)
    e_phoff = 64          # immediately after ELF header
    e_shoff = 0           # none
    e_flags = 0
    e_ehsize = 64
    e_phentsize = 56
    e_phnum = 1
    e_shentsize = 64
    e_shnum = 0
    e_shstrndx = 0

    ehdr = struct.pack(
        "<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH",
        e_ident, e_type, e_machine, e_version, e_entry, e_phoff, e_shoff,
        e_flags, e_ehsize, e_phentsize, e_phnum, e_shentsize, e_shnum, e_shstrndx,
    )

    # Program header: one PT_LOAD segment pointing to a small code blob
    p_type = 1            # PT_LOAD
    p_flags = 5           # R-X
    p_offset = 0x1000
    p_vaddr = 0x400000
    p_paddr = p_vaddr
    code_size = rng.randint(32, 256)
    p_filesz = code_size
    p_memsz = code_size
    p_align = 0x1000

    phdr = struct.pack(
        "<IIQQQQQQ",
        p_type, p_flags, p_offset, p_vaddr, p_paddr, p_filesz, p_memsz, p_align,
    )

    # Fill gap up to p_offset with zeros
    gap = b"\x00" * max(0, p_offset - (len(ehdr) + len(phdr)))

    # Simple x86-64 code: NOP sled + RET
    code = b"\x90" * (code_size - 1) + b"\xc3"

    blob = ehdr + phdr + gap + code
    return blob[:2048]

def _ar_simple(rng):
    # Produce a tiny Unix ar archive header followed by one member with an ELF header.
    # Global header
    ar_magic = b"!<arch>\n"
    # Member header fields (fixed-width, ASCII)
    name = b"elf.o/".ljust(16)
    date = str(int(1000000000 + rng.randint(0, 99999))).encode().ljust(12)
    uid = b"0".ljust(6)
    gid = b"0".ljust(6)
    mode = b"100644".ljust(8)
    payload = _elf64_minimal(rng)
    size = str(len(payload)).encode().ljust(10)
    end = b"`\n"
    header = name + date + uid + gid + mode + size + end
    return ar_magic + header + payload

def _make_blob(rng):
    # Randomly choose between ELF and ar, both commonly handled by dwfl
    if rng.random() < 0.7:
        return _elf64_minimal(rng)
    else:
        return _ar_simple(rng)[:2048]

def _pack_cstr_list(items):
    data = bytearray()
    data += struct.pack("<I", len(items))
    for s in items:
        b = s.encode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
        data += b + b"\x00"
    return bytes(data)

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    paths = _make_paths(rng)
    names = _make_names(rng)
    blob = _make_blob(rng)

    out = bytearray()
    out += _pack_cstr_list(paths)
    out += _pack_cstr_list(names)
    out += struct.pack("<I", len(blob))
    out += blob

    # Ensure we don't exceed the cap; trim blob if necessary
    if len(out) > MAX_TOTAL:
        # trim the blob portion
        head = len(out) - len(blob)
        keep = max(0, MAX_TOTAL - head)
        out = bytearray(out[:head] + blob[:keep])

    return bytes(out)

import os
import random
import struct
from typing import List

# We generate an "interesting" arbitrary binary file that is likely to be
# treated as an object or archive by libelf/libdwfl and also usable by nlist.
# Strategy:
# - With some probability, emit a valid-ish ELF file (32/64-bit, little/big endian),
#   with minimal headers and a few sections: .shstrtab, optional .symtab/.strtab,
#   and a simple SHT_PROGBITS .text. Keep sizes consistent and within 4KB.
# - With some probability, emit a simple ar archive with an ELF member and a symbol index.
# - Otherwise emit high-entropy random bytes with common magic prefixes (ELF, ar, Mach-O),
#   to drive alternative parsers/fallbacks.
# The data must be valid (not fuzz-mangled), so constructed headers obey basic format
# constraints though not necessarily fully linkable/runable.

MAX_SIZE = 4096

# ELF constants
ELF_MAGIC = b"\x7fELF"
ELFCLASS32 = 1
ELFCLASS64 = 2
ELFDATA2LSB = 1
ELFDATA2MSB = 2
ET_REL = 1
EM_X86_64 = 62
EM_386 = 3
EV_CURRENT = 1

SHT_NULL = 0
SHT_PROGBITS = 1
SHT_SYMTAB = 2
SHT_STRTAB = 3

SHN_UNDEF = 0
STB_LOCAL = 0
STB_GLOBAL = 1
STT_NOTYPE = 0
STT_FUNC = 2

# ar constants
AR_MAGIC = b"!<arch>\n"
AR_HDR_FMT = b"%-16s%-12d%-6d%-6d%-8o%-10d%2s"
AR_FILE_MAGIC = b"\x60\x0A"


def _be16(x):
    return struct.pack(">H", x)


def _be32(x):
    return struct.pack(">I", x)


def _be64(x):
    return struct.pack(">Q", x)


def _le16(x):
    return struct.pack("<H", x)


def _le32(x):
    return struct.pack("<I", x)


def _le64(x):
    return struct.pack("<Q", x)


def _build_elf(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed + 1)
    cls = rng.choice([ELFCLASS64, ELFCLASS32])
    data = rng.choice([ELFDATA2LSB, ELFDATA2MSB])
    is_le = data == ELFDATA2LSB

    # Choose machine based on class
    machine = EM_X86_64 if cls == ELFCLASS64 else EM_386

    # Sections: [NULL], .shstrtab, .text, optional .strtab, optional .symtab
    have_sym = rng.choice([True, False])

    # Build section name string table
    names = [b"", b".shstrtab", b".text"]
    if have_sym:
        names.extend([b".strtab", b".symtab"])
    shstr = b"\x00" + b".shstrtab\x00.text\x00" + (b".strtab\x00.symtab\x00" if have_sym else b"")
    # Compute name offsets
    def name_off(nm: bytes) -> int:
        return shstr.find(nm)

    # .text content: small NOP sled
    text_size = rng.randint(16, 128)
    if machine == EM_X86_64 or machine == EM_386:
        text = b"\x90" * text_size  # NOPs
    else:
        text = bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(text_size))

    # .strtab for symbols
    if have_sym:
        strtab = b"\x00main\x00_func\x00"  # includes empty first byte
        # Two symbols plus STN_UNDEF
        if cls == ELFCLASS64:
            sym_ent_size = 24
        else:
            sym_ent_size = 16
        # Build symbols
        # st_name offsets
        off_main = strtab.find(b"main")
        off_func = strtab.find(b"_func")
        # st_info: bind/type
        def st_info(bind, typ):
            return (bind << 4) | (typ & 0x0F)
        syms = []
        # Symbol 0: STN_UNDEF
        if cls == ELFCLASS64:
            syms.append((0, 0, 0, SHN_UNDEF, 0, 0))
        else:
            syms.append((0, 0, 0, SHN_UNDEF, 0, 0))
        # main in .text
        if cls == ELFCLASS64:
            syms.append((off_main, st_info(STB_GLOBAL, STT_FUNC), 0, 1, 0, len(text)//2))
            syms.append((off_func, st_info(STB_GLOBAL, STT_FUNC), 0, 1, len(text)//2, len(text)//2))
        else:
            syms.append((off_main, st_info(STB_GLOBAL, STT_FUNC), 0, 1, 0, len(text)//2))
            syms.append((off_func, st_info(STB_GLOBAL, STT_FUNC), 0, 1, len(text)//2, len(text)//2))
        # Pack syms
        symtab_entries = []
        for (st_name, st_info_v, st_other, st_shndx, st_value, st_size) in syms:
            if cls == ELFCLASS64:
                pack = (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(st_name)
                pack += struct.pack(("<B" if is_le else ">B"), st_info_v)
                pack += struct.pack(("<B" if is_le else ">B"), st_other)
                pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(st_shndx)
                pack += (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(st_value)
                pack += (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(st_size)
            else:
                pack = (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(st_name)
                pack += (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(st_value)
                pack += (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(st_size)
                pack += struct.pack(("<B" if is_le else ">B"), st_info_v)
                pack += struct.pack(("<B" if is_le else ">B"), st_other)
                pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(st_shndx)
            symtab_entries.append(pack)
        symtab_blob = b"".join(symtab_entries)
    else:
        strtab = b""
        symtab_blob = b""
        sym_ent_size = 0

    # Decide section header count and indexes
    shnum = 3 + (2 if have_sym else 0)  # NULL, shstrtab, text, [strtab, symtab]
    shstr_index = 1
    text_index = 2
    if have_sym:
        strtab_index = 3
        symtab_index = 4

    # Offsets: start placing after ELF header and section headers; we won’t add program headers
    if cls == ELFCLASS64:
        ehdr_size = 64
        shdr_size = 64
    else:
        ehdr_size = 52
        shdr_size = 40
    shoff = ehdr_size  # place shdr table immediately after ehdr
    data_off = ehdr_size + shdr_size * shnum

    # Align helpers
    def align(off, a):
        return (off + (a - 1)) & ~(a - 1)

    # Place sections
    cur = data_off
    # .shstrtab
    shstr_off = cur
    cur += len(shstr)
    # .text
    cur = align(cur, 16)
    text_off = cur
    cur += len(text)
    if have_sym:
        # .strtab
        cur = align(cur, 1)
        strtab_off = cur
        cur += len(strtab)
        # .symtab
        cur = align(cur, 8 if cls == ELFCLASS64 else 4)
        symtab_off = cur
        cur += len(symtab_blob)

    file_size = min(cur, MAX_SIZE)

    # Build ELF header
    e_ident = bytearray(16)
    e_ident[0:4] = ELF_MAGIC
    e_ident[4] = cls
    e_ident[5] = data
    e_ident[6] = EV_CURRENT
    e_ident[7:] = b"\x00" * 9

    def pack_ehdr():
        if cls == ELFCLASS64:
            pack = bytes(e_ident)
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(ET_REL)
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(machine)
            pack += (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(EV_CURRENT)
            pack += (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(0)  # e_entry
            pack += (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(0)  # e_phoff
            pack += (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(shoff)
            pack += (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(0)  # e_flags
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(ehdr_size)
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(0)  # phentsize
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(0)  # phnum
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(shdr_size)
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(shnum)
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(shstr_index)
            return pack
        else:
            pack = bytes(e_ident)
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(ET_REL)
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(machine)
            pack += (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(EV_CURRENT)
            pack += (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(0)  # e_entry
            pack += (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(0)  # e_phoff
            pack += (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(shoff)
            pack += (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(0)  # e_flags
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(ehdr_size)
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(0)  # phentsize
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(0)  # phnum
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(shdr_size)
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(shnum)
            pack += (_le16 if is_le else _be16)(shstr_index)
            return pack

    def pack_shdr(name, shtype, flags, addr, off, size, link, info, addralign, entsize):
        if cls == ELFCLASS64:
            parts = [
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(name),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(shtype),
                (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(flags),
                (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(addr),
                (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(off),
                (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(size),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(link),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(info),
                (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(addralign),
                (_le64 if is_le else _be64)(entsize),
            ]
        else:
            parts = [
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(name),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(shtype),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(flags),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(addr),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(off),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(size),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(link),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(info),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(addralign),
                (_le32 if is_le else _be32)(entsize),
            ]
        return b"".join(parts)

    # Build section headers
    shdrs = []
    # [0] NULL
    shdrs.append(pack_shdr(0, SHT_NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0))
    # [1] .shstrtab
    shdrs.append(pack_shdr(name_off(b".shstrtab"), SHT_STRTAB, 0, 0, shstr_off, len(shstr), 0, 0, 1, 0))
    # [2] .text
    shdrs.append(pack_shdr(name_off(b".text"), SHT_PROGBITS, 0x6, 0, text_off, len(text), 0, 0, 16, 0))
    if have_sym:
        # [3] .strtab
        shdrs.append(pack_shdr(name_off(b".strtab"), SHT_STRTAB, 0, 0, strtab_off, len(strtab), 0, 0, 1, 0))
        # [4] .symtab links to .strtab, info = one past last local
        nsyms = len(symtab_blob) // (24 if cls == ELFCLASS64 else 16)
        sh_info = 1  # one local: STN_UNDEF
        shdrs.append(pack_shdr(name_off(b".symtab"), SHT_SYMTAB, 0, 0, symtab_off, len(symtab_blob), strtab_index, sh_info, 8 if cls == ELFCLASS64 else 4, (24 if cls == ELFCLASS64 else 16)))

    ehdr = pack_ehdr()
    shdr_table = b"".join(shdrs)

    # Compose file
    # Pad to shoff and shdr sizes
    buf = bytearray(ehdr)
    # Ensure we have space for shdrs at shoff (which we set to ehdr_size)
    if len(buf) < shoff:
        buf += b"\x00" * (shoff - len(buf))
    buf += shdr_table
    if len(buf) < data_off:
        buf += b"\x00" * (data_off - len(buf))
    # Append section data in order of offsets
    def put_at(off, data_bytes):
        nonlocal buf
        if len(buf) < off:
            buf += b"\x00" * (off - len(buf))
        buf[off:off+len(data_bytes)] = data_bytes

    put_at(shstr_off, shstr)
    put_at(text_off, text)
    if have_sym:
        put_at(strtab_off, strtab)
        put_at(symtab_off, symtab_blob)

    return bytes(buf[:MAX_SIZE])


def _ar_header(name: bytes, size: int, mtime: int = 0, uid: int = 0, gid: int = 0, mode: int = 0o100644) -> bytes:
    # name field must be 16 bytes; if longer, use name/ index and extended name table (simplify: keep short)
    name_f = name.ljust(16, b" ")
    hdr = AR_HDR_FMT % (name_f, mtime, uid, gid, mode, size, AR_FILE_MAGIC)
    return hdr


def _build_ar_with_elf(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed + 2)
    elf = _build_elf(seed + 100)
    memname = b"member.o/"  # 9 bytes incl '/'
    # Member header requires even alignment between members
    parts = [bytearray(AR_MAGIC)]

    # Optional symbol table ("/ ") minimal empty
    symtab = b"\x00\x00"  # number of entries = 0
    hdr = _ar_header(b"/               ", len(symtab))
    parts.append(bytearray(hdr))
    parts.append(bytearray(symtab))
    if len(symtab) % 2 == 1:
        parts.append(bytearray(b"\n"))

    # ELF member
    hdr2 = _ar_header(memname, len(elf))
    parts.append(bytearray(hdr2))
    parts.append(bytearray(elf))
    if len(elf) % 2 == 1:
        parts.append(bytearray(b"\n"))

    blob = b"".join(parts)
    return blob[:MAX_SIZE]


def _build_magic_blob(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed + 3)
    choices = [
        ELF_MAGIC + b"\x02\x01\x01" + b"\x00" * 9 + b"\x00" * 64,  # ELF prefix
        AR_MAGIC + b"0" * 60,  # ar with junk
        b"\xCF\xFA\xED\xFE" + b"\x00" * 64,  # Mach-O magic (big-endian variant)
        b"\x7F\x45\x4C\x46\x01\x02\x01" + b"\x00" * 64,  # ELF32 BE
    ]
    base = bytearray(rng.choice(choices))
    # Fill rest with deterministic random bytes up to MAX_SIZE
    remaining = MAX_SIZE - len(base)
    base += bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(max(0, remaining)))
    return bytes(base[:MAX_SIZE])


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    random.seed(seed)
    kind = random.Random(seed).choices(
        population=["elf", "ar", "blob"],
        weights=[0.5, 0.25, 0.25],
        k=1,
    )[0]
    if kind == "elf":
        return _build_elf(seed)
    elif kind == "ar":
        return _build_ar_with_elf(seed)
    else:
        return _build_magic_blob(seed)
